newsitem.title: JAPAN: Calgon Carbon forms holding company in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Calgon Carbon forms holding company in Singapore.

text.p: Calgon Carbon Corp said on Tuesday it had formed a holding company in Singapore to manage its business in Asia and to strengthen sales in the region.
Pittsburgh-based Calgon Carbon produces coal-based granular activated carbon.

"The rapidly growing Asian region is a very important market for our company and we can expect increased use of coal-based granular activated carbon systems," Calgon Carbon's Tokyo office said in a statement. Further details of the holding company were not immediately available from Calgon Carbon's Tokyo office.
